items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Hannah Williams married Roger Wolfe Kahn the international banker's son.

ctx.x: And we went along like that for about a year I guess and then the show went on the road. And Hannah, no before the show went on the road, Hannah Williams married Roger Wolfe Kahn the international banker's son. And she married Roger Wolfe Kahn and Dorothy, my wife, took her place in the show. For a while. But then the show went on the road and Dorothy didn't go. They got somebody else. She stayed in New York with the baby.

To take care of the baby and I went on the road with the show. And when I came back why she had gotten together with her sister and they were both, I mean Hannah was going to get a divorce from Roger Wolf Kahn and my wife decided to divorce me and marry somebody with a lot of money. And that broke me up. That's the thing that, that's the thing that broke me up.

So I just, as a matter of fact, I went down to New Orleans with Glen Miller and Smith Bullew and Ray McKinley was on drums then. And worked down there for six months. But when I came back, seeing the whole situation. Dorothy had gotten married again, my wife and had gotten the baby, she had the baby and everything so I just sort of lost heart, you know. And not knowing how to cope with the situation, I just couldn't even play.
